test_title: PYST 02: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 01 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the highlighted word in the given sentence.

The athlete demonstrated remarkable **__agility __**during the gymnastics routine.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Stiffness**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"agility"** means the ability to move quickly and easily. (चुस्ती)

 
 
• **Example: **The cat’s agility allowed it to swiftly climb the tree.
 
 
 
• **"Stiffness" **refers to the lack of ease in movement or flexibility; rigidity. (कठोरता)
 
 
• **Example: **After sitting for hours, he felt stiffness in his legs.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'agility'** is **'stiffness'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Stiffness**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Nimbleness **(फुर्ती): The quality of being quick and light in movement.

 
 
• **Example:** The nimbleness of the dancer was captivating.
 
 
 
• **Prowess **(कौशल): Skill or expertise in a particular activity or field.
 
 
• **Example: **His prowess in martial arts is well-known.
 
 
 
• **Flexibility** (लचीलापन): The quality of bending easily without breaking.
 
 
• **Example:** Flexibility is important for a gymnast.
